description: Use when you track exploited vulnerabilities: CVEs CISA added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog since a date (since=YYYY-MM-DD), newest first, with date added, due date, vendor, product. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /vuln/kev/new, $0.003 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. KEV additions since a date, newest first (limit up to 200), not a lookup; for CVSS, EPSS and KEV status of one CVE use vuln_cve. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

since.description: Only entries added on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (not before 2021-11-03)
